internal/explain.Build resolves Memory→Signal→Decision→Action→Outcome chain with citations + confidence + Markdown render. internal/rollback.Compensator emits compensating Praxis action when Chronos signal flags regression (default predicate: spike/drop/anomaly ≥0.7) + writes olymp.rollback event. internal/scheduler: Queue port (Enqueue/Lease/Renew/Release/Stats) + MemoryQueue reference impl with priority FIFO, idempotent enqueue, lease TTL with auto-recovery on expiry, attempt counters. Worker drains the queue: lease → load → engine.Run → release with heartbeat goroutine that renews the lease while the loop runs. SQL-backed queue is a future story; the port lets a host swap implementations without changing workers.
